Absolutely delicious! Hidden gem. Go here!
Jan 2019 • Couples
I can’t believe I’ve only just gotten around to writing this review. Better late than never. 

Delisa is absolutely delicious! After weeks of Vietnamese cuisine, my boyfriend and I just wanted a simple salad. We got all we wanted and more from Delisa.

We had their salads and their sandwiches. I’m a picky eater, but nothing was too much trouble for them. The ingredients are fresh, tasty and so perfectly crispy and crunchy. 

After discovering Delisa, we ate here so many times. I cannot recommend this place enough. Go see for yourself. Also, extremely affordable!

Yes yes yes!!!!!hidden gem!
Jun 2019 • Couples
I’m normally not a big fan of sandwiches (especially when u think of horrible chains like
Subway and co) but the ones we had in this hidden shop were simply awesome. We had to two sets with one salad, one sandwich and a juice each. I think the set prices are absolutely appropriate - single items are a bit on the higher side but still worth it. I had a light beetroot salad, a green smoothie with spinach and a sandwhich Niçoise. Highly recommended! No mayo overload, no salt overload just straightforward! I prefer to taste all the fresh ingredients used instead of having a potpourri or mashed vegg and sauces. The best was the tuna: fresh, sliced pink tuna steak, no tinned stuff! Wholemeal bread made my choice to give it a go. 100% recommended! Yummy!!!
